entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press one. For technical support, press two. To speak with a representative, press zero or stay on the line.
Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought this VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago and it's just not accurate. I can't use it like this.
I'm very sorry to hear the VeloBand Pulse isn't meeting your expectations. I can definitely help you with the return process. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, hold on. Yes. It's VF-8675309. Look, I've been busy and I was worried I was going to miss the window to send it back. Can we just get this done?
Of course. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order, delivered about 15 days ago. Oh, **don't worry** about missing the window.
What do you mean? Don't most companies have like a 30-day policy?
Our **standard policy** for returns is actually **90 days** from the date of delivery. We want to ensure our customers have ample opportunity to try our products.
Wait, really? 90 days? Are you sure about that?
Yes, absolutely. You have **plenty of time** left. I can email you a return label right now if you'd like, or you can hold onto it for a while longer.
Wow. Okay. That... that actually changes things. I was rushing to get this sorted before a deadline. If I have that long, maybe I'll give it another try and see if I can figure it out.
That sounds like a great plan. And remember, if it still doesn't work out, you can call us back anytime in the next couple of months to get that return started.
That's a huge relief. Thank you so much for clarifying that for me. You've been really helpful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for choosing VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
